text: oh sorry i should be more clear, close up it doesnt really work either, but close up i could see it was staying within a face,
resolution: Clarification of req_2126 (close-up it also mis-paints but stays cleanly WITHIN a face) — addressed by the same fix (sha b362eca79). The clarification was the key insight: per-face fill was always correct (paint stays within one triangle), so the wrong-face selection was the raycast picking a non-visible back-face. pick() now prefers the nearest front-facing (visible) face. Delivered on req_2126.
